messages:
Alex Chen: Morning — I'm standing in for the usual DevEx standup today. Quick status:
- What I did: polished the TypeScript SDK quickstart (clarified ESM vs CJS), fixed a typo in the sample app README, and updated the install notes for macOS M1.
- Blockers: CI is failing when building mac wheels on M1 runners (error in native-ffi build). I couldn't repro locally on my Intel box.
- Today: open a small docs PR, push a diagnostic CI job for M1, and tag a packaging owner for help. @Jon Patel can you eyeball the packaging PR when it's up?

Maria Gomez: Thanks Alex — I can try an M1 repro tomorrow on my laptop. Do you have the failing CI job link?

Alex Chen: https://ci.internal/redwood/sampleapp/9823 (failing step: build-wheel). The log shows:
```
clang: error: unknown argument: '-mmacosx-version-min=10.9'
cc1plus: note: unrecognized command line option '-fno-omit-frame-pointer'
```
I'm guessing the toolchain on the runner is out-of-sync.

Jon Patel: @Alex good call. I can add a matrix job with an M1 runner and a different Xcode combo. Also will look at the packaging scripts (wheel tags). If you can drop a minimal repro script I can iterate faster.

Alex Chen: Dropping a tiny repro in the PR — includes the docker-based build and a small patch to the setup.cfg.

Sarah L: Quick FYI — I noticed two docs pages still reference `redwood-sdk@beta` instead of `redwood-sdk@latest`. I left inline comments in the docs PR I opened earlier.

Alex Chen: Nice catch, thanks. I pulled those changes into my branch so the quickstart and sample README are consistent.

Maria Gomez: I ran the sample locally on an M1 VM — I hit a different segfault during `pip wheel`. Pasting the failing command and a minimal workaround I used: 
```
# workaround: force use of system libstdc++
CXXFLAGS=\"-stdlib=libc++\" python -m pip wheel .
```
Worked for me but it's a little fragile.

Jon Patel: Good workaround. I'll try adding that as an optional step guarded by an `if darwin and arch == arm64` check in CI.

devbot: PR #3247 created by Alex Chen: "docs: quickstart + sample app packaging fixes" (<https://git.internal/redwood/pull/3247>) :github: :tada:

Alex Chen: PR up now, requesting review from @Jon Patel and @Sarah L. No rush but would love a quick once-over on the packaging bits. :thumbsup:

Sarah L: Will review this afternoon. If CI errors are flaky we can land the docs part first and iterate on the wheel fix separately.

Jon Patel: Sounds good. I'll queue a small CI matrix change + try the repro. If I get stuck I'll ping infra.

Alex Chen: Thanks all — action items: Maria to capture M1 log, Jon to add CI matrix + review PR, Sarah to review docs copy, Alex to push a diagnostic CI job. I'll post updates here when I have PR feedback. :sparkles:
